user.description:
Specify the Tasmota discovery prefix.

⚠️ **Important Note on OTA Updates:**
Firmware updates always carry inherent risks due to device hardware constraints (such as limited flash memory on ESP8266/ESP8285 devices, power interruptions, or network conditions). It is strongly recommended to test updates on a single device first before updating all devices in bulk. Failed updates or safeboot states on individual devices are typically caused by hardware/network/flash constraints during Tasmota's internal OTA process and do not indicate a bug in this integration.
user.title: Tasmota Firmware Update
